timeline.summary: Yawgmoth manifests as a black cloud through a portal in the Stronghold in Urborg.
timeline.quote: This monstrous manifestation emerged through a portal located deep within the Stronghold in Urborg .

timeline.summary: The cloud blots out the sun, kills and reanimates the fallen as servants of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: killing anything it touched, and reanimating the fallen as mindless servants of Phyrexia.
